weight_mode: Adaptive area times variance at sample time; refreshed once per GP version and frozen within search
run_end: End sampling when no next sampling leg fits, or at 300 s; run and measure the final return separately.
initial_gp: SRF synthetic history from the same realization; fixed real-data-fitted RBF hyperparameters, no kernel refit
reconstruction: Retrospective final posterior over the common full [0,300] domain; not a forecasting test
gp_update: Every 1 s; all observations retained; fixed kernel hyperparameters
grg_update: Single worker, one replaceable latest-state signal, no FIFO; current search completes, next search starts with latest offered GP/context
goal_switch: Switch sampling goals only at arrival; persist the sampling route tail. Home can be a sampling waypoint.
execution_mode: Latest-GP background WIVR scheduling; retained route with arrival-only handoff
terminal_residual: Keep all timely measurements. Do not request sampling or planning during final return.
